evidence.name: Screen field: Fill behind the error text
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Fill behind the error text" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Fill behind the error text
sections.description: Sets a fill color behind the validation error message that appears when an answer is rejected. Usually leave it transparent so only the red text shows; add a subtle tint only if you want the error to read like a banner. Whatever you choose, keep enough contrast with the error text so the message stays readable and users can quickly fix and continue.
